title: Tanikala
summary: A community-driven, predictive early-warning platform that pairs verified field scout reports with weather dispersal data to alert smallholder farmers of pest threats through existing analog barangay networks.
highlights: Mobilizes volunteer barangay scouts and technicians to standardize pest detection through crop damage patterns via SMS and mobile web.
Uses open-source weather and wind data to forecast pest migration vectors before regional outbreaks spread.
Reaches smallholder farmers without smartphones by broadcasting verified alerts through analog channels like barangay loudspeakers and sari-sari stores.
